label: Adzuna
terms_note: Public Job Search API (app_id + app_key, free tier). Aggregator — applications land on the employer/original board, so search only.

reference.verdict: **Verdict** — has_api: **yes** (aggregator search API, apply on the source board).
auth: 1. Register at developer.adzuna.com (username, e-mail, organisation name + website) → `app_id` + `app_key`.
2. Both are mandatory query parameters on every call. No user context.

endpoints.notes: salary distribution, salary over time, vacancies by company / region

reference.limits: Not published on the docs pages (plans are managed by the 3scale portal); the Labour Market Intelligence tier is commercial. - Free key for the public API; organisation name and website are required at signup. - The developer T&C page could not be opened (404); general Adzuna site terms apply. - Aggregator — no account actions, so no automated-application question.

fields.name: app_id
fields.help: Adzuna app_id from https://developer.adzuna.com/ (register with username, e-mail, organisation name + website); mandatory app_id query parameter on every call.

fields.name: app_key
fields.help: Adzuna app_key from https://developer.adzuna.com/; mandatory app_key query parameter on every call.

me.note: Verified with a one-result UK search (Adzuna has no account endpoint).

search.note: The country is a path segment (gb, us, de, fr, ... per the Adzuna site); this server is pinned to gb (UK). description is cropped by Adzuna and redirect_url opens the ad on the original board. Rate limits are not published (plans are managed by the 3scale portal).

not_offered.get_posting: Page: 'no details endpoint — redirect_url opens the ad on the original board'; re-read the record from the search hit.
not_offered.apply: Page: 'applying happens there' (on the original board); 'Aggregator — no account actions'.
not_offered.list_messages: No messaging API: 'Aggregator — no account actions'.

evidence: probe: 2/2 tools answered on their documented path with an auth refusal, a validation error or data; control route -> 404 (not_found), so the answers are path-specific
